title: (Re)Labeling and preference: Evidence from air quality standards and housing markets in South Korea
Cold plays: Temperature and manufacturing production in India
Does environmental information provision deliver? Experimental evidence from China
Farm or forest? Quasi-experimental evidence from payment for ecosystem services in China
Feel the burn: Mental and behavioral responses to air pollution in China
Protecting the center: Environmental regulation and regional inequality in China
Can technology solve the principal-agent problem? Evidence from China's war on air pollution
abstract: We examine the introduction of automatic air pollution monitoring to counter suspected tampering at the local level, a central feature of China’s “war on pollution.” Exploiting 654 regression discontinuity designs based on city-level variation in the day that monitoring was automated, we find an immediate and lasting increase of 35 percent in reported PM10 concentrations post-automation. Moreover, automation’s introduction increased online searches for face masks and air filters, which are strong predictors of purchases. Overall, our findings suggest that the biased and imperfect information prior to automation led to suboptimal investments in defensive measures, plausibly imposing meaningful welfare costs. (JEL D82, O13, P28, Q53, Q55, Q58)
abstract_zh: 我们考察了为应对地方层面涉嫌篡改数据的问题而引入自动化空气污染监测的情况，这是中国“污染防治攻坚战”的一个核心特征。利用基于城市层面自动化监测启用日期差异构建的654个断点回归设计，我们发现，自动化之后，报告的PM10浓度立即且持久地上升了35%。此外，自动化的引入还增加了对口罩和空气过滤器的网络搜索，而这些搜索是购买行为的有力预测指标。总体而言，我们的发现表明，自动化之前有偏且不完善的信息导致了防御性措施投资的次优，可能带来了可观的福利损失。（JEL D82, O13, P28, Q53, Q55, Q58）

title: Statistical evidence on the impact of agricultural straw burning on urban air quality in China
Straw burning, PM2.5 and death: Evidence from China
The unintended impacts of agricultural fires: Human capital in China
abstract: The practice of burning agricultural waste is ubiquitous around the world, yet the external human capital costs from those fires have been underexplored. Using data from the National College Entrance Examination (NCEE) and agricultural fires detected by high-resolution satellites in China during 2005 to 2011, this paper investigates the impacts of fires on cognitive performance. To address the endogeneity of agricultural fires, we differentiate upwind fires from downwind fires. We find that a one-standard-deviation increase in the difference between upwind and downwind fires during the exam decreases the total exam score by 1.42 percent of a standard deviation (or 0.6 point), and further decreases the probability of getting into first-tier universities by 0.51 percent of a standard deviation.
abstract_zh: 焚烧农业废弃物的做法在世界各地普遍存在，然而，这些火灾造成的外部人力资本成本却未得到充分研究。本文利用2005至2011年中国全国普通高等学校招生考试（高考）数据，以及高分辨率卫星探测到的农业火灾数据，考察了火灾对认知表现的影响。为解决农业火灾的内生性问题，我们区分了上风向火灾和下风向火灾。结果发现，考试期间上风向火灾与下风向火灾之差每增加一个标准差，将使考试总分降低1.42个标准差（即0.6分），并进一步使考入第一批高校（一本）的概率降低0.51个标准差。

title: Avoidance behavior against air pollution: Evidence from online search indices for anti-PM2.5 masks and air filters in Chinese cities
Time series forecasting of air quality based on regional numerical modeling in Hong Kong
abstract: Based on prevailing numerical forecasting models (Community Multiscale Air Quality [CMAQ] model , Comprehensive Air Quality Model with Extensions, and Nested Air Quality Prediction Modeling System) and observations from monitoring stations in Hong Kong, we employ a set of autoregressive integrated moving average (ARIMA) models with numerical forecasts (ARIMAX) to improve the forecast of air pollutants including PM2.5, NO2, and O3. The results show significant improvements in multiple evaluation metrics for daily (1–3 days) and hourly (1–72 hr) forecast. Forecasts on daily 1‐hr and 8‐hr maximum O3are also improved. For instance, compared with CMAQ, applying CMAQ‐ARIMA reduces average root‐mean‐square errors (RMSEs) at all stations for daily average PM2.5, NO2, and O3in the next 3 days by 14.3–21.0%, 41.2–46.3%, and 47.8–49.7%, respectively. For hourly forecasts in the next 72 hr, reductions in RMSEs brought by ARIMAX using CMAQ are 18.2% for PM2.5, 32.1% for NO2, and 36.7% for O3. Large improvements in RMSEs are achieved for nonrural PM2.5and rural NO2using ARIMAX with three numerical models. Dynamic hourly forecast shows that ARIMAX can be applied for forecast of 7‐ to 72‐hr PM2.5, 4‐ to 72‐hr NO2, and 4‐ to 6‐hr O3. Besides applying ARIMAX for NO2, we recommend a mixed forecast strategy to ARIMAX for normal values of PM2.5and O3and employ numerical models for outputs above 75th percentile of historical observations. Our hybrid ARIMAX method can combine the advantage of ARIMA and numerical modeling to assist real‐time air quality forecasting efficiently and consistently.
abstract_zh: 基于现有的数值预报模式（社区多尺度空气质量模型[CMAQ]、带扩展功能的综合空气质量模型以及嵌套空气质量预报模型系统），并结合香港监测站点的观测数据，我们采用了一组带数值预报的自回归积分滑动平均（ARIMA）模型（ARIMAX），以改进对PM2.5、NO2和O3等空气污染物的预报。结果显示，在日预报（1至3天）和小时预报（1至72小时）的多项评价指标上均有显著改善。日均1小时和8小时最大O3的预报也得到了改善。例如，与CMAQ相比，应用CMAQ-ARIMA可使未来3天各站点日均PM2.5、NO2和O3的均方根误差（RMSE）分别降低14.3%至21.0%、41.2%至46.3%和47.8%至49.7%。对于未来72小时的逐时预报，利用CMAQ的ARIMAX可使PM2.5的RMSE降低18.2%，NO2降低32.1%，O3降低36.7%。使用三种数值模式的ARIMAX，在非农村地区PM2.5和农村地区NO2的RMSE方面取得了较大改善。动态逐时预报显示，ARIMAX可用于7至72小时的PM2.5预报、4至72小时的NO2预报，以及4至6小时的O3预报。除将ARIMAX应用于NO2外，我们还建议对PM2.5和O3的常规数值采用ARIMAX与数值模式相结合的混合预报策略，而对于超过历史观测第75百分位数的数值，则采用数值模式。我们的混合ARIMAX方法结合了ARIMA和数值模式的优势，能够高效、一致地支持实时空气质量预报。

title: Particulate air pollution and mortality in 38 of China's largest cities: Time series analysis
abstract: Objectives To estimate the short term effect of particulate air pollution (particle diameter 200 million). Participants 350 638 deaths (200 912 in males, 149 726 in females) recorded in 38 city districts by the Disease Surveillance Point System of the Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention from 1 January 2010 to 29 June 2013. Main outcome measure Daily numbers of deaths from all causes, cardiorespiratory diseases, and non-cardiorespiratory diseases and among different demographic groups were used to estimate the associations between particulate air pollution and mortality. Results A 10 µg/m3 change in concurrent day PM10 concentrations was associated with a 0.44% (95% confidence interval 0.30% to 0.58%) increase in daily number of deaths. Previous day and two day lagged PM10 levels decreased in magnitude by one third and two thirds but remained statistically significantly associated with increased mortality. The estimate for the effect of PM10 on deaths from cardiorespiratory diseases was 0.62% (0.43% to 0.81%) per 10 µg/m3 compared with 0.26% (0.09% to 0.42%) for other cause mortality. Exposure to PM10 had a greater impact on females than on males. Adults aged 60 and over were more vulnerable to particulate air pollution at high levels than those aged less than 60. The PM10 effect varied across different cities and marginally decreased in cities with higher PM10 concentrations. Conclusion Particulate air pollution has a greater impact on deaths from cardiorespiratory diseases than it does on other cause mortality. People aged 60 or more have a higher risk of death from particulate air pollution than people aged less than 60. The estimates of the effect varied across cities and covered a wide range of domain.
abstract_zh: 目的：估计颗粒物空气污染（颗粒直径 200 million）对短期死亡的影响。研究对象：2010年1月1日至2013年6月29日，中国疾病预防控制中心疾病监测点系统在38个城区记录的350,638例死亡（男性200,912例，女性149,726例）。主要结局指标：采用全因、心肺疾病、非心肺疾病的每日死亡人数，以及不同人口学群体的每日死亡人数，估计颗粒物污染与死亡率之间的关联。结果：当日PM10浓度每变化10 µg/m³，每日死亡人数增加0.44%（95%置信区间为0.30%至0.58%）。前一日和滞后两日的PM10水平所带来的效应分别减弱了三分之一和三分之二，但仍与死亡率增加保持显著的统计关联。PM10每变化10 µg/m³，对心肺疾病死亡的影响为0.62%（0.43%至0.81%），而对其他原因死亡的影响为0.26%（0.09%至0.42%）。PM10暴露对女性的影响大于男性。在高污染水平下，60岁及以上的成年人比60岁以下的成年人更为脆弱。PM10的效应在不同城市间存在差异，且在PM10浓度较高的城市中略有下降。结论：颗粒物空气污染对心肺疾病死亡的影响大于对其他原因死亡的影响。60岁及以上人群因颗粒物污染而死亡的风险高于60岁以下人群。效应估计在各城市间存在差异，且范围较广。
